summary: Accessor that reads a float at offset 0xF30 of the object pointed to by the pointer stored at this+0x0. First dereferences this to obtain the target object, then loads the float at object+0xF30 and returns it. No branches, guards, globals, or callees.

operations.description: Dereference this to obtain the target object pointer stored at this+0x0.
Load and return the float at the target object's offset 0xF30 (byte offset 3888).

unresolved: The owning class of both this and the dereferenced object is unknown; the packet provides no owner evidence.

The meaning of the float at object+0xF30 as a lifetime average is taken from the existing-analysis label and ABI legacy name (DERIVED); the field could equally be any scalar quantity, and the accessor reads only through a single pointer hop.
The raw source declares a double return type while the value loaded is a 32-bit float; the discrepancy was not reconciled in this packet.
